label: early copy phase, re-input of a/c/d
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never during the original tokens or on <DEL>. It is concentrated on copy steps 2-5 (recall_idx peaks at 3-4; nothing at recall_idx 0, almost nothing at 1) and in longer sequences (L 7-9). It fires only on repeated inputs (in_first=0), meaning the fed-back copy of an original token. The input token matters a lot: a (10x lift, 38% of mass), then d and c (about 5x), then f, s, 0, y, q, n; it is close to silent on i, u, v. The strongest activations are on a/c/d fed back at copy position 2-3, and the activation often carries over with decay onto the next one or two copy steps. It is quiet at the end of the copy phase. Precision is only about 0.2, because most a/c/d inputs at these positions do not fire, and the profile tables do not show what separates the ones that do. The unit is also very weak in absolute terms (max about 0.001).
